history.dynasty: Nayagarh princely state patronage (19th-century kings - verify)
history.period: Built around 1903 (per tourism sources; one source says Middle Ages - verify)
history.summary: The Raghunathjew Temple at Odagaon, Nayagarh district, is one of Odisha's best-known Rama temples. It holds wooden (neem) idols of Raghunath, Sita and Lakshman, unusual in Hindu temple art. The sanctum depicts Rama in two forms - Banavasi (woodland/hunter aspect) and Abhisheki (royal aspect). Legend links the site to sage Atri Muni's Yagna Kunda and to Kavisamrat Upendra Bhanja, who is said to have meditated here, mastered the Rama Taraka Mantra and composed his magnum opus Baidehisha Vilasa at the deity's feet. The temple rose to prominence with support of 19th-century Nayagarh kings. It is built in Kalinga style with a pyramidal vimana topped by three gold kalashas; three mandapas (Bhadra, Nata, Darshan); clay models narrating the Ramayana; and a small museum in the complex. The dating is conflicting across sources (1903 per most travel sources; 'Middle Ages' per one listing) - verify.

name: Raghunathjew Temple
town: Odagaon (CSV town 'Nayagarh' is the district; the temple is at Odagaon, ~26 km from Nayagarh town)
town_description: Odagaon is a town in Nayagarh district, Odisha, about 26 km from Nayagarh (the district headquarters) and roughly 90-100 km from Bhubaneswar (verify). It is best known for the Raghunathjew Temple and the literary association with Odia poet Upendra Bhanja. Nayagarh district lies in the coastal-plain-to-Eastern-Ghats transition with the Mahanadi river to its north; nearby attractions include the Ladubaba and Nilamadhab temples.

travel.airport: Biju Patnaik International Airport, Bhubaneswar - about 90-120 km from Odagaon (verify).
travel.railway: Nayagarh Town station (Khurda Road-Bolangir line), about 26 km away; Khurda Road Junction is the nearest major railhead (verify distances).
travel.road: Odagaon is on the Ambarapura-Bhadikila Road, about 26 km from Nayagarh bus stand; buses and private vehicles connect from Nayagarh and Bhubaneswar (verify).

visitor_information.best_time: October to March for pleasant weather. Rama Navami (March-April) is the grandest festival but crowded.
